summary: PHASE 0 (CVLN-GOV-AUDIT-001) — Targeted retest of the Telegram push failure bug identified in iteration_4. Backend fix (POST /api/notifications/test now returns HTTP 200 with {result, pushed, push_error}) verified end-to-end through the Cloudflare ingress: pytest TestNotifications 4/4 GREEN, curl through the public URL returns HTTP 200 application/json with the expected structured body, and the notification is persisted in db.notifications. Frontend Playwright on mobile viewport 390x844: login OK, /command loads, [data-testid='test-notification-btn'] click produces a clean sonner toast ‘Push Telegram indisponible — founder chat_id not discovered yet (send /start to the bot)’ — NO HTML leak, NO Cloudflare wall-of-text, page does not crash. Non-regression: [data-testid='connect-telegram-btn'] returns a clean 404 toast (‘Aucun message reçu — envoie /start au bot @cvln puis réessaie.’), and Dashboard + Agents navigation still work after these actions.
critical_code_review_comments: notification_routes.send_test — clean fix: contract is now (200, {result, pushed, push_error}), which cannot be swallowed by any ingress. Good defensive design.

api.js formatApiError — HTML guard (`detail.trimStart().startsWith('<')`) + 240-char truncation is sensible; would also apply to Array joined strings if any element happens to start with '<' (edge case, not blocking).
CommandMobile.testNotif — reads data.pushed correctly and passes data.push_error through formatApiError, which handles the (unlikely here) HTML edge case. UX is now correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (test-notif toast clean, connect-telegram toast clean, nav Dashboard+Agents OK)

seed_data_creation: 1 additional 'Test CVLN Command' notification (level 3, source=founder-console) added by the pytest + 1 by the frontend click. Safe, purely additive, matches iteration_4 conventions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PHASE 0 bug is fully closed. Backend contract for POST /api/notifications/test is now HTTP 200 with body {result: 'sent'|'persisted_only', pushed: bool, push_error: str|null}. Do NOT assert 502 anymore. test_iteration4.py::TestNotifications::test_send_test_returns_502_but_persists_notification is misnamed (still says 502) but its body correctly asserts 200 + structured JSON — safe to leave, or rename to test_send_test_returns_200_with_push_error for clarity.
rca of the issue: Fix verified. Root cause was: (1) backend raised HTTPException(502) on push failure, (2) Cloudflare replaced the origin 502 body with a static HTML 'Bad gateway' page, (3) frontend rendered that HTML in a sonner toast. Fix applied — backend now returns HTTP 200 with {pushed:false, push_error:'…'} (option (a) from iteration_4 rca), frontend reads data.pushed and calls formatApiError on push_error which also has a defensive HTML guard + 240-char truncation. End-to-end verification: curl through public URL returns HTTP 200 application/json with clean body; Playwright toast reads 'Push Telegram indisponible — founder chat_id not discovered yet (send /start to the bot)'; notification persisted in db.notifications (visible in GET /api/notifications and in the mobile UI list).
